## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is small and reviewable; commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Docs updated, including `CLAUDE.md` if commands, structure, or conventions changed.
- [ ] Significant technical decisions are recorded as an ADR in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] Tests added or updated, or not applicable (docs only).
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or personal data in the diff.
- [ ] No new dependency or paid service without the choice and alternatives explained.
- [ ] No mocks or stubs, or each one is approved, labeled `// MOCK:`, and listed in `docs/mocks.md`.

## Guardrails (complete if the change touches user data or user-facing surfaces)

- [ ] Every product guardrail in `CLAUDE.md`, section 4, still holds. Name any it touches.
- [ ] Report, block, and moderation paths still work (if the app has them).
- [ ] No new personal data collected, or the privacy policy and store answers are updated.
- [ ] Not applicable.
